resource_time_note: Event wall time includes API/selection/revision time; these fields overlap and must not be added.
forecast_resource_scope: All persisted score records including failed runs; forecasts interrupted before score persistence are not recoverable.
limitations: Posthoc addition after the common-confirmation inputs and RL/LLM outcomes were exposed. Five paired training seeds and forty type-specific paths. Base-stock has no training seed; its values are broadcast solely for paired model/path differences. LLM receives extra notification, global system states and forecast computation. This deployment-system comparison does not establish isolated semantic benefit, equal information, or equal compute. Secondary/type intervals are descriptive.
inference: Exploratory additional baseline on already exposed common-confirmation paths; intervals descriptive, not a newly preregistered prospective test.
